# Denver Paint Contractors (Bighorn Painting)

> Denver Paint Contractors is the Denver website of Bighorn Painting, a locally owned painting contractor founded in 2023 at 12191 W 64th Ave Unit 102-8, Arvada, CO 80004. Bighorn paints home exteriors and interiors, kitchen cabinets, doors and trim, stains decks and fences, and handles commercial painting across Denver, Jefferson County and the Front Range.

## Key facts
- Phone: 720-912-4676, answered Monday through Saturday, 7am to 7pm
- Email: asa@bighornpainting.com
- Google rating: 4.9 stars across 95 reviews
- Warranty: 5-year workmanship warranty, in writing with the estimate; paint also carries manufacturer warranties
- Paint brands: primarily Sherwin-Williams and PPG
- Estimates: free, either virtual from photos or in person; free color consultation included
- Insurance: insured, with proof of coverage at the estimate (Colorado has no statewide painting license)
- Service area: Denver, Arvada, Wheat Ridge, Golden, Lakewood, Edgewater, Westminster, Broomfield, Thornton, Northglenn, Louisville, Superior, Aurora, Englewood, Littleton, Centennial, Highlands Ranch
- Related site: https://bighornpainting.com/

## Pricing context
Angi's Denver cost data puts exterior house painting at roughly $1.55 to $4.10 per square foot. Interior painting in Denver is commonly quoted between $1.50 and $3.50 per square foot. These are market ranges, not Bighorn's price list; Bighorn provides free written estimates.
